Bengals vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 23 · NFL Week 11 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 23, 11:51 AM ET

Joe Burrow has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bengals at Commanders DraftKings Showdown: 22.5 points at $11,000 FLEX, 33.8 at captain for $16,500. Across 100,000 simulations Burrow holds 70% of the winning-lineup credit.

Ja'Marr Chase has the largest captain share: 17.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Chase at captain. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 35.4 routes. Jayden Daniels is the next captain in line, at 16.1%. The model has him running 5.8 times.

Cincinnati is a 6-point favorite, and the implied totals are 30.25 for the Bengals and 24.25 for the Commanders.

Behind Burrow, Chase and Daniels, the next projections are Chase Brown (17.5, $9,400), Tee Higgins (16.8, $10,600) and Stefon Diggs (12.1, $8,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 23, 11:51 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Ja'Marr Chase, CIN WR ($11,600 FLEX / $17,400 CPT)

Ja'Marr Chase holds 17.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,400 and the 22.4-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 35.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Chase averaged 22.4 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 46.5. He holds 58% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.6% as the captain and 40.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 16.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 21.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 32.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 5.8 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Daniels averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 13.9 and a ceiling of 40.5. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.1% as the captain and 51.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Joe Burrow, CIN QB ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

Joe Burrow holds 12.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 22.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Burrow averaged 22.6 points with a simulated floor of 12.2 and a ceiling of 41.2. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.7% as the captain and 57.3% in a FLEX spot.

Chase Brown, CIN RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Chase Brown carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 17.5 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). The model gives him 14.5 carries and 5.5 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Brown averaged 17.4 points with a simulated floor of 5.8 and a ceiling of 34.4. He holds 50% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.6% as the captain and 38.1% in a FLEX spot.

Across 100,000 simulations Higgins averaged 16.8 points with a simulated floor of 3.7 and a ceiling of 40.3. Stefon Diggs carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.1 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model gives him 7.0 targets on 25.2 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Diggs averaged 12.1 points with a simulated floor of 0.6 and a ceiling of 38.4. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.7% as the captain and 18.4% in a FLEX spot.

Chig Okonkwo, WAS TE ($4,000 FLEX / $6,000 CPT)

Chig Okonkwo carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.5 DraftKings points for a $4,000 FLEX salary ($6,000 at captain). The model gives him 5.5 targets on 26.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Okonkwo averaged 11.6 points with a simulated floor of 2.5 and a ceiling of 25.4. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.1% as the captain and 39.4% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Samaje Perine, CIN RB ($4,400 FLEX / $6,600 CPT)

Samaje Perine projects for 8.3 DraftKings points at a $4,400 FLEX salary, 1.88 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 6.6 carries and 1.4 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Perine averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 2.5 and a ceiling of 15.1. He holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.2% as the captain and 20.1% in a FLEX spot.

Dohnte Meyers projects for 6.6 DraftKings points at a $3,600 FLEX salary, 1.84 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.6 targets on 19.6 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Meyers averaged 6.6 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 18.7. He holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.7% as the captain and 17.2% in a FLEX spot.
